objective: Download and hash exactly the three registered residual benchmark PDFs, normalize them with already-installed Docling native and standard_no_ocr runtimes, and evaluate deterministic scan/text/layout openers plus semantic-figure region locators before any newly selected model family is installed or invoked.

required_state.research_daemon: inactive/dead PID 0 before, throughout, and after

allowed_inference: Docling standard_no_ocr using the already-installed validated layout/TableFormer cache only
forbidden_actions: install or download any newly selected OCR/VLM/local-semantic model or runtime
enable global OCR or general document VLM routing
invoke Codex or any semantic model
write evidence, verification, gap, checkpoint, research-run, or human-review scientific state
relax residual opener thresholds merely to keep a selected source case
fetch_acceptance: Each source response begins with PDF magic and is saved under the visible audit output root.
SHA-256, byte size, and exact PDF page count are recorded.
Public-source expected page count must match the downloaded PDF; mismatch fails closed.
Public web parses/screenshots are not benchmark authority and are not used by production openers.

scan_mixed_quality_v1: At least one page fires SCAN_IMAGE_ONLY_OR_TEXTLESS_PAGE.
At least one page fires LOW_CONFIDENCE_TEXT_OR_OCR_RECOVERY.
All opener evidence comes from the downloaded authoritative PDF plus normalized native/standard outputs.
semantic_visuals_v1: Both target figure labels are found in standard_no_ocr caption blocks.
Before model prefetch is opened, each target must resolve to exactly one caption-linked figure asset with a PDF bbox.
malformed_layout_v1: At least one registered target page fires LAYOUT_OR_READING_ORDER_ANOMALY under the durable opener thresholds.
If neither target opens, decision is REJECT and the source case must be replaced before any layout-model inference.

pass_condition: All three registered cases are accepted, semantic visual region locators are ready, new candidate model downloads/inference remain zero, scientific state remains untouched, and the daemon remains inactive/dead.
failure_behavior: Stop at the first hard runtime/download failure; for a completed deterministic audit with a residual rejection, preserve the visible audit report, return nonzero, leave the daemon stopped, and revise/replace only the failed source case before proceeding.
next_on_pass: Durably record authoritative source hashes/opener results, then open a separate bounded runtime/model prefetch gate for the already-selected candidates. This source-audit runner itself never downloads those weights.
